source.name: Sportico – 'Real Salt Lake, Utah Royals Sign Jersey Deal With Intermountain'
source.quote: The seven-year agreement has an average annual value in the mid-seven figures.

note: Seven-year partnership announced 14 February 2024 spanning Real Salt Lake and NWSL Utah Royals: RSL jersey front (Select Health brand in 2024, Intermountain Health brand from 2025), Intermountain sleeve, and official medical provider. Sportico reports an average annual value in the mid-seven figures; SportsPro cited Sportico for 'roughly US$75 million, or between US$9 million and US$10 million annually', which Sportico's updated story no longer supports — no exact figure recorded.
